steps.name: install-portable-model-path
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = bd6a4e28a8898fd6b17ed68009d0436d1562c06e; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7d/climate_model_artifact.py > tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7d/test_climate_model_artifact.py > tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7d/export_winner_runner.py > tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage7d/train_climate_v6.py > tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: portable-model-focused-gate
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py tests/test_climate_training.py tests/test_climate_dataset_parallel.py -q; .venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py; git diff --check

steps.name: export-reproduced-winner
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; PYTHONPATH="$PWD" CLIMATE_DATASET_WORKERS=6 .venv/bin/python tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
report = json.loads(Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json').read_text())
meta = json.loads(Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.json').read_text())
assert report['training']['winner'] == 'adam_huber'
assert report['artifact']['weights_sha256'] == meta['weights_sha256']
assert meta['schema_version'] == 6
assert len(meta['feature_names']) == 38
assert len(meta['output_names']) == 6
assert meta['parameter_count'] == 2502
assert Path('reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.npz').stat().st_size > 0
print('PORTABLE_ARTIFACT_VALIDATION=PASS')
PY
git diff --check; git status --short

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish-portable-model
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.npz; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_model_artifact.py tools/ml/export_climate_v6_winner.py tools/ml/train_climate_v6.py tests/test_climate_model_artifact.py reports/ml/climate_v6_training_seed1847.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.json reports/ml/climate_v6_model_seed1847.npz; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Persist portable climate v6 winner'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
